title.label: I love the new TFS app setup. HOWEVER!!!

content.label:
I love the new TFS app setup. HOWEVER!!! The app has so many glitches. They go as follows:

•  I can’t press the back button when I enter into a new section of the app. For example when I click to see my transactions or statements or to look at my banking info I can’t go back to the main page. EVERY TIME I have to close the app and religiously into get to a new section. It’s VERY FRUSTRATING!!!

•I also miss the fact that it used to ask for my social before payment. Why did you remove that feature? It made me feel safe and secure that no one could access my account without personal info. Putting in ones info was a standard requirement needed to access or pay a bill in anyone’s account.

•It also paid a bill from an account I did not authorize and an account that I no longer have. When I looked into it, I notice that there was another account I no longer have as well. I have no idea how it managed to retain 2 old accounts I had removed already in the old app.

Please fix these issues. Thank you.

I’ve had nothing but problems using the Toyota app. The thing that drives me nuts most about it is they constantly updated and then they forced you to change your password while also using a two factor authentication. In every eight months to a year, I have to stop and entering a brand new password. Then when you go back and do it again, it says you can’t use any passwords that resemble your past five passwords even though all the numbers are mixed up. Now they updated a new privacy policy and every time I pull up the privacy policy on my phone it doesn’t allow me to click an option to accept it so I can continue to make a payment on my phone using the Toyota financial app. I’ve even gone on my computer at home and accepted the new Toyota privacy policy and it continues to show on my phone, no matter what. When it’s on my phone, it blocked me from using the app and there’s no buttons or scrolling ability to accept the new privacy policy which renders the app ultimately useless and I can no longer use it on my phone. My credit card company my bank doesn’t even have policies this ridiculous and stringent. In this digital age, you should be able to use an app on your phone to make basic payments, it’s not that complicated, wake up Toyota and get your act together, this is an amateur hour.

title.label: The new update needs to be fixed.

content.label:
A lot of people have complained about the app but it generally does not cause me issues. However, after updating the app yesterday I have had issues posting my payments, ensuring the transactions are processed the same day, and setting up recurring payments. My payments are always due on the first of each month and yesterday the app consistently froze, transactions were posting for the next day (not the current day) and when I tried to set up recurring payments it did not set up the payments until next month. I’ve had to cancel and attempt to re-post transactions which I’m glad I noticed today because my account says past due. I have never been late so this is slightly frustrating since the issues stem from the app. Every time I try to review my transactions it either says I have no transactions, or that I have three transactions from the first to post on the 2nd (one canceled) and then it freezes. Please update this for bugs as I was excited since I really do enjoy the new interface.

UPDATE: Now I am charged TWICE. I went from no transactions to two transactions. It makes no sense. Thank God I can afford two transactions because someone else may not be as fortunate and would have to call their bank to cancel. Please fix the payment options.

title.label: Automatic Payments are impossible to stop

content.label: I bought a Tacoma in 2021 I had the truck for 2 years and sold it. The car was paid off the contract was fulfilled and I went on Toyota financials app and stopped all recurring payments. That was back in June, now it’s October and I get my truck payment taken out of my account. So I called TFS and they said that THE ONLY WAY TO STOP THE AUTOMATIC PAYMENTS IS THROUGH THE APP. So I downloaded TFS again and opened the app and now automatic payments have been resumed. So from now until 2027 my payment will continue to be charged. The representative said I could go into the account and delete my bank account information. I cannot, the account access is restricted because of course the truck is paid off and there is no balance or loan on it. I can’t stop the payments either, they’re scheduled but again TFS HAS NO OTHER WAY OF STOPPING PAYMENTS. Not even managers not even department heads could turn off these charges. So I had to call my bank and request a stop on all charges coming out of Toyota. So now I can’t buy another car or finance another one through TFS unless I open a separate bank account specifically for that car. Because if I use the same bank before 2027 I will still have my truck payment on top of the new car payment.

The app, in my opinion, needs a thorough overhaul, or it is designed this way intentionally by Toyota and its subsidiaries to cause unnecessary/unwarranted fees to accrue for profit.

title.label: Do NOT Make Changes In App

Finally, all of my bank information was erased.  You should have people that can do better then this.  Also, the updated picture of the car I am paying off is the wrong color.  I am not even sure if your update has me paying off the correct car.  Please fix this.

This is by far the worst Financial Website I have ever encountered.  The website freezes up constantly and I have to close it out and start over every time it freezes.  It took me six times to set up a single monthly payment today and every month I make a payment, it freezes up multiple times before I can actually make a payment.  Toyota has absolutely failed in customer service, besides failing to give me my second key fob for my car after payment and waiting six months to receive it.  Worst investment I have ever made on a vehicle. Also, the onboard car’s computer is absolutely faulty too. An absolute “LEMON.”  The car’s computer cannot tell the difference between an actual road hazard and an anomaly in the vicinity of the car, including speed limits signage’s.  Worst overall investment I have ever made and serious buyers’ remorse. The End!!

Do not trust the recurring payment option. The app updated and it canceled all of my recurring payments, causing me to be a few days past due, and when I panicked and hit “pay now” it automatically made me pay for the past due bill as well as the next month’s payment. Thankfully paying two payments at once didn’t wreck my finances for the month, so I just set the recurring payments back up, triple checked everything, and the very next time I had to make a payment, the exact same thing happened. At the risk of being dramatic, my credit score could plummet because of this, and my car could ultimately get repossessed. I have never in my life been so much as one day late with any payment, and I’ve been late twice because I trusted this app. Never again will I trust this app to actually go through with recurring payments the way it’s supposed to.

Love Toyota but seems like they’re lacking the basic foundation of what makes an app that takes payment truly an app that makes you feel supportive in the process. 

Through the COVID-19 Pandemic the app offers a Payment Relief which directs you to the website. This made me realize. If you look at the mobile website versus the app; the mobile website has more tool bar features such a “support center”. This blows my mind. Something so simple not available in the app. If the user needs support, they need to go to the site. Now get this... the support center on the site doesn’t let you even properly generate tickets in the drop down. It’s as if they forced you to call them.

All in all, the most basic feature that should be on the app for me at least makes me rate this app one star. Toyota, you guys need to step up your app game. Almost every review is sharing the same thing; poor quality

I had to reset my password because I was not being logged in. I used the same info that I tried to login in with the first time because it wasn’t working and I thought I would set it right. I tried multiple times with the pass I had on record. Unnecessarily difficult. I will complain about other inconveniences on the phone, personally to an operator when I have time. No more to waste here

First few months I had no issue making my payments, everything was dandy. Then they got an update and my payments were being returned. I had to open a new account because it was not taking it from the account I had initially set up. I always pay on time and try to stay ahead. I receive my September statement and it shows a lower outstanding balance then what the app is showing. After being on the phone for over an hour, they cannot figure out why it shows that. They show a larger balance and cannot even pull up my statement and tell me that I am probably one of the many people that don’t know how to use the app. They tell me that a manager will call within 24-48 hours and I don’t receive a call. I call back and they still can’t help me out. I love Toyota but I will NOT be financing anymore vehicles with Toyota Financial.

What is up with this new update on the app?? The login consent was a bunch of crap before but now it’s even worse I dont know what you guys were thinking and you are definitely going to loose a bunch of people with this. The consent agreements were long before and you had to accept every time you logged in now they’re even longer and you can’t even access the app. I haven’t been able to access the app I keep agreeing with the consent forms and all it does is refresh them and keep me in the same login screen. I don’t understand why it’s mandatory to keep agreeing to these same things EVERY single time you try to login what’s the point? I make my payments and other things through this app and now I can’t even access it because of this. This new update and consent agreement features are going to be the death of this app and trust me there are many people that hate these same things

If you read reviews from 1 year ago they posted how they got charged twice. Come my time to use this app and it happened to me. Don’t set up auto pay on the website nor on the app it doesn’t connect you account which is the dumb thing I’ve ever heard. So I had $900 come out when I don’t have that luxury made me negative in my bank account. As well they have the worst return policy they mail you a check that they say takes 10 business day I’m on day 15. The customer service isn’t 24/7. Plus the customer service team belittles when you call. Worst service and experience I will pay my car and pray to god I don’t have to use them ever again. I’ll get my money by the next payment. I will get more fees on my bank thanks to stupid app/website not connecting your account or them addressing that.

I like that Toyota has their own app to make your payments but a couple of months ago I used the app like I normally do and he gave me a confirmation number and everything turns out the next month I get a notification on my credit port saying that I missed a payment for Toyota financing dropped my score 30 points I was so mad cause I didn’t miss the payment luckily I had the confirmation number and created a dispute with my credit report show the proof that I paid it days before the due date it took another month for my score to go up those 30 points.

The app is cleaner and moves faster than the Toyota app, which is nice. I find it annoying how they have the Privacy Choices and Performance Tracking set up.

For Privacy Choices, it doesn’t tell you whether the default is allowing or disallowing the sharing of your information, and there’s no indication on the toggle. The website leads me to believe they are defaulted to off, and I can only assume then that the toggle color being gray means it is off.

The app seems to remember all my settings except for in Performance Tracking. And these settings also don’t have clear indications as to whether the default is allowing or disallowing the tracking, and no indication on the toggles. Every time I open the app the toggles for allowing that tracking are set so that they are red, presumably allowing. I can turn them off, but they will reset when I reopen the app. There is an option to Anonymize Personal Data, but it appears to default to off and will not remember if I change it.

When everything else works properly and is labeled well, these two problems come across as intentionally vague and sleazy.

content.label: Anytime I try to login whether it’s with my Apple ID  fingerprint or username/password, a pop up message comes on saying that they’re having technical difficulties on their end and to please try again later. That happens too often in the app and some things are time sensitive where I can’t wait later to try again, only to get the same pop up message when I wait hours or even days. Once I finally get to login, which is after multiple attempts on different days, then it works good. I’m able to use it as intended, however, it’s still so frustrating trying to get into the app. Please fix this issue, I don’t understand why it makes it so difficult to do something so simple as just logging in.

Straight forward, succinct, not 352 pages of disclaimers before you get to the meat of the program. I went there today to set up the recurring payment schedule and everything I needed was within the first page of two. Actually, that is as far as I got because it was so easy and user friendly. It will take me longer to write this review than it did to set up and confirm the payment schedule - and I’m fine with that! (Pro-Tip: I anticipated needing the routing and account # for the payment to be withdrawn from before I opened the application so I had that ready to go.)

I bought a toyota last year in July. The app then was ok. It worked but the UI wasn't the strongest and it had some weird login tendencies and other issues. But overall it worked fine. With the changes they've made in the last month or two, its like a new app. Very intuitive, easier to pay, easier to track, etc. they made some very welcome changes and put a-lot of thought into their now new app. I would have given it 5 stars before but it wasn't a “leave a review 5 stars worthy” type of app in my opinion . Well now it is.

I switched banks and used the app to set up the new bank for autopay. On the app, my old bank account is gone and my new bank is loaded and I’m thinking, “okay cool we’re set.” NOPE! TFS still took payment from my old account before I could close it and over-drafted the account. Although the app has all my current information, it did not sync with the desktop site and still has my old bank information. So I had to also update the website to make sure all future payments come from the correct account. You might as well use the desk top site for your TFS needs since the app doesn’t actually work. I have never had this issue with any other app so please figure this app out. You are a major car manufacturer and can afford a department for app development and maintenance. This was very annoying and inconvenient.

I pay my bill ON THE DATE it is due every month. When I did this for September it accepted the payment, it usually takes up to a week for the payment to go through so I waited. It’s been 2 weeks and when I saw that the money was still in my  account and the app was not letting me log in. I had to call them and they said my account had insufficient funds which is a lie because my account always has 2-3x more than what I need for my bills. The fact that no one called me about a late payment is insane I could’ve had my car repod for no reason and been left without a car. They took off the late payment and I finally got the money taken out of my account. This is ridiculous that I have to make something happen when it’s Toyotas responsibility to want to make some money.

I have been using this App for over 3 years with every update it gets worse than before, every time you update this app, all your personal preferences such as Touch ID, security questions and a bunch of other annoying settings will be deleted and you have to start fresh and also the developers change the entire layout of this app with every update and that’s never been better than before and poor you the user have to get used to the new scattered dashboard etc, another annoying thing with Toyota financial is that they fetch bunch of terms and agreements via this app that you have to agree every month or so and that always comes with each update, I use more than 30 big banks and brokerages app this App by far the worst app, probably couple of 7th grade middle school kids are the developers!

As a TFS user, when I bought my car from an authorized Toyota dealer in the KC area in 2023, they let me know I’d have the ease of an app to make payments, get a payoff quote if I ever got to pay the car note off early, easy customer service and support and more! You can pay a custom amount weekly if you wanted for your loan or all at once on the due date! You can set up auto payments or pay as you go! Love that type of ease for those who are living paycheck to paycheck, breaking down payments weekly helps! By far the easiest and best car financing option I’ve ever had!

The recently updated app is terrible. I usually make my payments a week early but it was declined. I tried to make my payment again after the due date and it was declined again. I tried again for a third time yesterday but my payment was due on 7/26. I am absolutely never late on any payment on anything and I’m incredibly disappointed. Don’t bother calling support either, you will wait on hold for over 30 minutes just to hear they’re working on it. I’m expecting leniency and an apology to all of the people having the same issue with the updated app but the apparent lack of concern and communication on their behalf is also frustrating. I have financed my last two vehicles through Toyota but, due to this experience, I will probably go with another option on the next round.

reviews.review_text: This app might work ok, but my ACH payment made in April 2024 was somehow “lost” by Toyota Financial. They claimed it failed, but I sent in proof from my bank and the treasury dept showing all the tracking information. The dealersh p attempted to help me sort it out and they couldn’t get it fixed either. Every time e I call it’s another story. reviews.review_text: App lacks the ability to set a recurring payment on principal. It only allows for a one time, which makes it tedious to set up over the course of the life of the loan. You also cannot call to have any extra payments be paid on principal either. I was told that this feature may become available soon, but that’s what I would say if I wanted to smooth things over with no timeline or release date. It’s too bad that everything up until this point with purchasing a new Toyota has been outstanding. Do better, Toyota. Do better.

reviews.author: kilometerspf
reviews.review_text: I bought a Tacoma in 2021 I had the truck for 2 years and sold it. The car was paid off the contract was fulfilled and I went on Toyota financials app and stopped all recurring payments. That was back in June, now it’s October and I get my truck payment taken out of my account. So I called TFS and they said that THE ONLY WAY TO STOP THE AUTOMATIC PAYMENTS IS THROUGH THE APP. So I downloaded TFS again and opened the app and now automatic payments have been resumed. So from now until 2027 my payment will continue to be charged. The representative said I could go into the account and delete my bank account information. I cannot, the account access is restricted because of course the truck is paid off and there is no balance or loan on it. I can’t stop the payments either, they’re scheduled but again TFS HAS NO OTHER WAY OF STOPPING PAYMENTS. Not even managers not even department heads could turn off these charges. So I had to call my bank and request a stop on all charges coming out of Toyota. So now I can’t buy another car or finance another one through TFS unless I open a separate bank account specifically for that car. Because if I use the same bank before 2027 I will still have my truck payment on top of the new car payment.

reviews.author: lovethetruckhatetheapp
reviews.review_text: I’ve used the app to make payments since I got my loan last year in March. Never had any problems until the last three months when it kept “having technical problems” processing my payment (at the time, no update available). I paid through the website (I am grateful that at least worked), but shouldn’t have to since that’s an app’s main objective. Thankfully, this month, after I updated, it is working again. The app developers definitely dropped the ball on Toyota, I have had more serious issues with this app than any other financial app I’ve ever used, but since it does work the majority of the time, I’ll keep it as long as I have Toyota holding the loan. The app is at least partially responsible for my decision to refinance sooner rather than later... *side note* This app requires way too many updates. Get it right the first time, and update once a year for bugs. People are only on there once a month and updating it every time you try to open an app..it gets old.

reviews.review_text: I am not very pleased with the Toyota Financial Services App. I setup an automatic payment onto a different bank account months ago, which was confirmed by app, and it did not setup correctly due to sluggishness and malfunctioning. I am setting up an automatic payment again, but due to the unreliability of the app, I am forced to verify through an agent on the Toyota Financial Services Customer service line that the app/account are correct this time. I also had to setup email/text alerts through customer service. The app, in my opinion, needs a thorough overhaul, or it is designed this way intentionally by Toyota and its subsidiaries to cause unnecessary/unwarranted fees to accrue for profit.

reviews.review_text: TFS does currently offer the best interest rates on new Toyotas, but I guess you get what you pay for. I generally pay by phone, but their phone system rarely works. TFS also took 7 months to get me the paperwork I needed to prove I owned the Tacoma I bought so I could get it registered, and that took countless phone calls and promises that they were going to mail me the copy of my title (which never arrived even though I called them every month for several months). While I absolutely love my Tacoma, financing with TFS has been nothing but headaches.

reviews.author: Servian Wall
reviews.review_text: The app is cleaner and moves faster than the Toyota app, which is nice. I find it annoying how they have the Privacy Choices and Performance Tracking set up. For Privacy Choices, it doesn’t tell you whether the default is allowing or disallowing the sharing of your information, and there’s no indication on the toggle. The website leads me to believe they are defaulted to off, and I can only assume then that the toggle color being gray means it is off. The app seems to remember all my settings except for in Performance Tracking. And these settings also don’t have clear indications as to whether the default is allowing or disallowing the tracking, and no indication on the toggles. Every time I open the app the toggles for allowing that tracking are set so that they are red, presumably allowing. I can turn them off, but they will reset when I reopen the app. There is an option to Anonymize Personal Data, but it appears to default to off and will not remember if I change it. When everything else works properly and is labeled well, these two problems come across as intentionally vague and sleazy.
